Question:
In triangle \(ABC\), base \(AB = 14\) cm and the perpendicular height from \(C\) to \(AB\) is \(9\) cm. Find the area of the triangle in square centimetres. Enter the number only.

[Figure 1](figures/triangle-area.svg)
Solution:
The area of a triangle is half the product of its base and perpendicular height:
\[A = \frac{1}{2} \times 14 \times 9 = 63.\]
The area is \(63\) square centimetres.
